title: Two Women Outdoors Portrait, 1940s Vintage B&W Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white full-length snapshot featuring two women standing together on a grassy lawn outside a residential house during the late 1940s. The older woman on the left wears a printed dress with pearl necklaces and wire-rimmed glasses, while the younger woman on the right wears a stylish buttoned peplum jacket and pleated skirt ensemble. The photograph has characteristic deckled edges and showcases post-World War II American domestic life.
